sudo docker exec inho_backend python -c "
import asyncio, os
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy import text
engine = create_async_engine(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])
async def run():
    async with engine.begin() as c:
        r1 = await c.execute(text(\"UPDATE inho.users SET role='ADMIN' WHERE email='admin@inho.com'\"))
        r2 = await c.execute(text(\"UPDATE inho.users SET role='OPERATOR' WHERE email='auto_operador3@inho.com'\"))
        rows = await c.execute(text(\"SELECT email, role FROM inho.users WHERE email IN ('admin@inho.com','auto_operador3@inho.com')\"))
        for row in rows:
            print(row)
asyncio.run(run())
"
